recognize_zh: 骨髓切片低倍下，上半部骨小樑間的髓腔被淡粉紅、細胞較少且呈纖維化的浸潤病灶取代，與下半部含脂肪與巨核細胞的正常造血組織界線清楚；這種局灶纖維化浸潤是 CHL 侵犯骨髓的典型低倍表現。
features: Upper intertrabecular spaces replaced by a pale, paucicellular fibrotic infiltrate with streaming spindle cells
Scattered small lymphocytes within the fibrotic area; large atypical cells not resolvable at this magnification
Relatively sharp demarcation from residual normocellular trilineage hematopoiesis with fat and megakaryocytes in the lower field
Bony trabeculae intact without obvious remodeling
describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow core biopsy shows patchy replacement of the upper intertrabecular spaces by a pale, paucicellular fibrotic infiltrate with streaming spindle cells and scattered lymphocytes. This is sharply demarcated from residual trilineage hematopoiesis with adipocytes and megakaryocytes in the lower portion. Individual Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells cannot be resolved at this magnification. In a patient with classic Hodgkin lymphoma, this focal fibrotic infiltrate is suggestive of marrow involvement, to be confirmed by high-power identification of HRS cells with CD30/CD15 immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: PMF shows diffuse reticulin fibrosis with clustered atypical megakaryocytes and intrasinusoidal hematopoiesis throughout the core, not a sharply demarcated polymorphous infiltrate with HRS cells.
Metastatic carcinoma forms cohesive epithelial nests within the fibrosis that are cytokeratin-positive.
Mastocytosis forms paratrabecular or perivascular fibrotic aggregates of spindled mast cells with eosinophils that are tryptase and CD117 positive rather than CD30+/CD15+ HRS cells.

ddx.dx: Serous fat atrophy or post-therapy stromal change
ddx.vs: Gelatinous transformation is pale, amorphous and acellular without spindle-cell fibrosis or inflammatory cells.
